elements.label: Dark green dot that pops in and starts stretching into a pill

pattern.description: On a flat light-green field, a small dark dot pops in (rising slightly, with a faint soft shadow beneath it on the first frame), grows to a circle and, at the end of the burst, begins stretching horizontally into a pill shape, setting up a shape-to-UI morph.
pattern.why_premium: A single primitive shape carries the scene change: the pop gives a tactile 'drop' with a soft shadow, and the circle-to-pill stretch promises a transformation (likely into a control or label), giving continuity between sections without text or a cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.dot', {scale: 0, y: 10, autoAlpha: 0}, {scale: 1, y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'back.out(1.4)'}).to('.dot', {width: 88, borderRadius: 999, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '+=0.05');
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 14, stiffness: 220, mass: 0.6}}); transform: translateY(${(1 - s) * 10}px) scale(${s}); then width = interpolate(frame, [14, 22], [64, 88], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) with borderRadius 9999.

notes: The burst ends just as the dot starts widening (energy rises again on the last two frames), so the pill morph probably continues into the next event. b02 is a spurious OCR box ('●'); b03 is a union box including the shadow area, not used.
